body:
# BetterChatReborn

This mod compacts duplicate messages, removes blank messages, expands the chat history up to 16384, disables telemetry, ignores name account bans and always allows chat. All features are toggleable.


> Client-side only; it does not need to be installed on the server and changes nothing
> for other players.

## Features

| Feature | Description | Applies |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Compact duplicate messages** | Repeated chat messages collapse into a single line with an `(x2)`, `(x3)` … counter instead of flooding your chat. The most recent copy is moved to the bottom and its count is updated. | Instantly |
| **Remove blank messages** | Messages whose visible text is empty (after stripping formatting) are dropped before they ever reach chat. | Instantly |
| **Expand chat history** | Raises the stored chat backlog from the vanilla 100 lines up to **16,384** (sent-history, message queue, and recent-chat ring buffer ). | After restart |
| **Bypass chat restrictions** | Always reports chat, multiplayer, and Realms as allowed, ignores account name bans, and disables telemetry sessions. | After restart |

Toggling **Compact duplicate messages** or **Remove blank messages** takes effect
immediately. **Expand chat history** and **Bypass chat restrictions** hook low-level
client state that is built once at startup, so they require a restart to change.

## Configuration

BetterChatReborn uses [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) +
[Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) for an in-game settings screen:

1. Open the **Mods** menu (Mod Menu).
2. Find **BetterChatReborn** and click the **settings (cog)** icon.
3. Toggle features and click **Save**.

Settings live in `.minecraft/config/betterchatreborn.json` and can also be edited by hand
(defaults shown):

```json
{
  "compactMessages": true,
  "removeBlank": true,
  "expandHistory": true,
  "bypassChatRestrictions": true
}
```

The file is created automatically on first launch, and is re-created with defaults if it
is missing or unreadable.

## Installation

1. Install the [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) (0.19.3+) for Minecraft 26.1.2.
2. Drop the following into your `.minecraft/mods` folder:
   - **BetterChatReborn** (`betterchatreborn-<version>.jar`)
   - [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
   - [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)
   - [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)
3. Launch the game.

## Dependencies

| Mod | Required |
| --- | --- |
| [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) | Yes |
| [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) | Yes |
| [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) | Yes |

## Requirements

| | Version |
| --- | --- |
| Minecraft | 26.1.2 |
| Fabric Loader | ≥ 0.19.3 |
| Java | ≥ 25 |

## Credits

BetterChatReborn reimplements concepts from other chat mods: message compacting
(Compacting by celestialfault), expanded history (MoreChatHistory by JackFred), and the
chat-restriction bypass (No Chat Reports / No Chat Restrictions by Aizistral).
